why: This is a purpose-built research corpus and dataset, not a reusable instructional element.
name: Corpus of 100 children's picture books (68,103 words)
product_description: A corpus created by Montag Jessica L. et al. containing the text of 100 children's picture books selected for study of language input and early vocabulary learning among children aged 0 to 60 months.

why: This is a named botanical vocabulary diagnostic test, so it is an assessment instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: 100-word range of information test in botany
product_description: A 100-term botanical vocabulary and information test developed by Grier for assessing first-year high-school pupils' plant-life knowledge carried from nature study and school gardens.

why: The 107th Japanese National License Examination for Pharmacists is a named, reusable licensing assessment benchmark rather than a general instructional element.
name: 107th Japanese National License Examination for Pharmacists (JNLEP)
product_description: A 345-question Japanese pharmacist licensing examination administered by Japan and reused by researchers to benchmark generative AI performance on pharmacy knowledge and problem solving.
